    AI Overview
    Yes, mail is delivered on Good Friday
    . Because it is not a federal holiday, the U.S. Postal Service (USPS) operates, delivers mail, and keeps post offices open with normal hours. Additionally, UPS and FedEx typically provide regular pickup and delivery services on Good Friday. 
    Good Friday Mail & Business Summary: 
    • USPS: Normal delivery and post office hours.
    • UPS: Regular pickup and delivery services.
    • FedEx: Operating, with some services having modified hours.
    • Banks/Businesses: Many remain open, though some private businesses may adjust hours.
    • Stock Markets: Closed. 
    Note: There is no regular mail delivery on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, though Priority Mail Express is available.

    Are banks closed on Good Friday in the USA?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Most banks in the US remain
    open on Good Friday because it is not a Federal Reserve holiday    . However, some local branches may close, and many banks will observe it as a holiday in states like Connecticut, Texas, and Louisiana. The stock market is closed, but mail delivery operates normally. 
    Key Takeaways for Good Friday: 
    • Banks: Most are open, but check your local branch as some might have adjusted hours or close (especially in the ~12 states that recognize it as a holiday).
    • Stock Market: Both the NYSE and Nasdaq are closed.
    • Mail/Shipping: USPS operates normally. FedEx and UPS typically operate with standard or slightly modified service.
    • Federal/State Offices: Federal offices are open, but state and county offices in certain states may be closed.
    • Online Banking: Always available, though some transactions may not process until Monday. 
    For the most accurate information, check your specific bank's website for hours on April 3, 2026.
